paragraphs.source_en: Between his headquarters at Sasao and the positions of his vanguard commanders, Shima Sakon Katsutake and Gamō Bitchū-no-kami Satōie, Ishida Mitsunari erected two lines of palisades and moved Shima and Gamō forward to defend them. These palisades were intended not merely to guard against an enemy assault, but also to provide positions for firearms and cannon.

units.source_en: Between his headquarters at Sasao and the positions of his vanguard commanders, Shima Sakon Katsutake and Gamō Bitchū-no-kami Satōie, Ishida Mitsunari erected two lines of palisades and moved Shima and Gamō forward to defend them.
units.source_zh: 石田三成在笹尾本阵和前锋岛左近胜猛、蒲生备中守乡舍之间，筑了两道栅栏，并把岛、蒲生二将调到栅栏前。

units.source_en: These palisades were intended not merely to guard against an enemy assault, but also to provide positions for firearms and cannon.

ja.t: ぐためだけのものではなく、ここに

units.source_zh: 设此栅栏并非只是为了防备敌人来袭，更要在这里安置枪炮。

paragraphs.source_zh: 石田三成在笹尾本阵和前锋岛左近胜猛、蒲生备中守乡舍之间，筑了两道栅栏，并把岛、蒲生二将调到栅栏前。设此栅栏并非只是为了防备敌人来袭，更要在这里安置枪炮。

paragraphs.source_en: After the Shimazu opened hostilities, Ikoma Kazumasa and Kanamori Nagachika of the Eastern Army followed close behind Tanaka Yoshimasa and launched an attack on Ishida's forces. Shima and Gamō fought fiercely against the four Eastern Army commanders Takenaka, Tanaka, Ikoma, and Kanamori.

units.source_en: After the Shimazu opened hostilities, Ikoma Kazumasa and Kanamori Nagachika of the Eastern Army followed close behind Tanaka Yoshimasa and launched an attack on Ishida's forces.
units.source_zh: 岛津开战之后，东军的生驹一正和金森长近紧跟田中吉政，向石田发起了进攻。

units.source_en: Shima and Gamō fought fiercely against the four Eastern Army commanders Takenaka, Tanaka, Ikoma, and Kanamori.
units.source_zh: 岛、蒲生二将与东军的竹中、田中、生驹、金森四将展开了激战。

paragraphs.source_zh: 岛津开战之后，东军的生驹一正和金森长近紧跟田中吉政，向石田发起了进攻。岛、蒲生二将与东军的竹中、田中、生驹、金森四将展开了激战。

paragraphs.source_en: At that moment, Kuroda Nagamasa alone held his troops back. Kuroda harbored a deep hatred for Mitsunari. Nagamasa had served Hideyoshi since childhood and was a great favorite of Nene. He and Mitsunari had clashed over everything since their youth, and their resentment had festered to this day.

units.source_en: At that moment, Kuroda Nagamasa alone held his troops back.
units.source_zh: 当时，唯有黑田长政一人按兵不动。

units.source_en: Kuroda harbored a deep hatred for Mitsunari.
units.source_zh: 黑田对三成颇为憎恨。

units.source_en: Nagamasa had served Hideyoshi since childhood and was a great favorite of Nene.
units.source_zh: 长政幼时就追随秀吉，深得宁宁欢心。

units.source_en: He and Mitsunari had clashed over everything since their youth, and their resentment had festered to this day.
units.source_zh: 他与三成从小就事事不和，积怨至今。

paragraphs.source_zh: 当时，唯有黑田长政一人按兵不动。黑田对三成颇为憎恨。长政幼时就追随秀吉，深得宁宁欢心。他与三成从小就事事不和，积怨至今。

paragraphs.source_en: Though both men were former retainers of Hideyoshi, Nagamasa regarded Mitsunari as treacherous, cunning, and narrow-minded. Their conflict had erupted during the war in Korea; after returning, they became bitter enemies, and today they finally faced each other on the battlefield.

units.source_en: Though both men were former retainers of Hideyoshi, Nagamasa regarded Mitsunari as treacherous, cunning, and narrow-minded.
units.source_zh: 尽管二人都是秀吉旧将，但长政眼中的三成阴险狡诈、心胸狭窄。

units.source_en: Their conflict had erupted during the war in Korea; after returning, they became bitter enemies, and today they finally faced each other on the battlefield.
units.source_zh: 朝鲜战争时，二人的矛盾爆发，回来之后便反目成仇，今日终于在战场上兵戎相见。

paragraphs.source_zh: 尽管二人都是秀吉旧将，但长政眼中的三成阴险狡诈、心胸狭窄。朝鲜战争时，二人的矛盾爆发，回来之后便反目成仇，今日终于在战场上兵戎相见。

paragraphs.source_en: Before Ishida's position stood not only two lines of palisades; to the right of the highway were Ōtani Daigaku, son of Yoshitsugu, together with Hideyori's archers, arquebusiers, and yellow-clad troops, while Mount Aikawa lay to the north. Mitsunari deemed his defenses impregnable.

units.source_en: Before Ishida's position stood not only two lines of palisades; to the right of the highway were Ōtani Daigaku, son of Yoshitsugu, together with Hideyori's archers, arquebusiers, and yellow-clad troops, while Mount Aikawa lay to the north. Mitsunari deemed his defenses impregnable.
units.source_zh: 石田阵前不仅设了两重栅栏，官道右手还有吉继之子大谷大学和秀赖的弓箭、火枪营和黄衣军，北面则为相川山，自谓固若金汤。

paragraphs.source_zh: 石田阵前不仅设了两重栅栏，官道右手还有吉继之子大谷大学和秀赖的弓箭、火枪营和黄衣军，北面则为相川山，自谓固若金汤。

paragraphs.source_en: That Mitsunari should keep Hideyori's elite troops at his own side was such an arrogant usurpation of authority that Nagamasa found it utterly absurd—if defeated, Mitsunari would surely flee along the highway. Do you think I will let you escape? I shall take your head with my own hands! With all these considerations in mind, Nagamasa, who had quietly watched since the fighting began, slipped around north of Aikawa and moved into Ishida's flank and rear.

units.source_en: That Mitsunari should keep Hideyori's elite troops at his own side was such an arrogant usurpation of authority that Nagamasa found it utterly absurd—if defeated, Mitsunari would surely flee along the highway.
units.source_zh: 三成竟把秀赖精锐放在自己身边，这种僭上行为，不禁让长政觉得可笑至极——万一失败，三成定会从官道逃跑。

units.source_en: Do you think I will let you escape?
units.source_zh: 怎会让尔逃掉？

units.source_en: I shall take your head with my own hands!
units.source_zh: 定要亲手取尔首级！

units.source_en: With all these considerations in mind, Nagamasa, who had quietly watched since the fighting began, slipped around north of Aikawa and moved into Ishida's flank and rear.
units.source_zh: 出于种种考虑，混战伊始，一直静静观望的长政，悄悄从相川北绕到了石田侧后。

paragraphs.source_zh: 三成竟把秀赖精锐放在自己身边，这种僭上行为，不禁让长政觉得可笑至极——万一失败，三成定会从官道逃跑。怎会让尔逃掉？定要亲手取尔首级！出于种种考虑，混战伊始，一直静静观望的长政，悄悄从相川北绕到了石田侧后。

paragraphs.source_en: Kuroda Nagamasa had long since seen through their fond calculations. That was precisely why he had made the flanking maneuver and now suddenly struck the flank of Shima Sakon's troops near Aozuka.

units.source_en: Kuroda Nagamasa had long since seen through their fond calculations.
units.source_zh: 黑田长政早就洞悉了他们的如意算盘。

units.source_en: That was precisely why he had made the flanking maneuver and now suddenly struck the flank of Shima Sakon's troops near Aozuka.
units.source_zh: 正因如此，他才迂回包抄，突然间向青冢一带的岛左近部侧翼发起袭击。

paragraphs.source_zh: 黑田长政早就洞悉了他们的如意算盘。正因如此，他才迂回包抄，突然间向青冢一带的岛左近部侧翼发起袭击。

units.source_en: “One hundred and fifty.”
units.source_zh: “一百五十。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Good. Pick out fifty of them, aim at the enemy commanders, and give them a merciless volley!”

units.source_en: “Good. Pick out fifty of them, aim at the enemy commanders, and give them a merciless volley!”
units.source_zh: “好，挑出五十支来，瞄准敌方主将，给我狠狠打！”

paragraphs.source_zh: “好，挑出五十支来，瞄准敌方主将，给我狠狠打！”

paragraphs.source_en: Meanwhile, Tanaka Yoshimasa's men, who had attacked Shima Sakon Katsutake from the ditch ahead, fought as they withdrew and withdrew as they fought. Despite the relentless harassment from Tanaka's troops, Shima Katsutake kept smiling and met their attacks with perfect composure.

units.source_en: Meanwhile, Tanaka Yoshimasa's men, who had attacked Shima Sakon Katsutake from the ditch ahead, fought as they withdrew and withdrew as they fought.
units.source_zh: 此时，从前面的沟堑中向岛左近胜猛发起进攻的田中吉政人马，且战且退，且退且战。

units.source_en: Despite the relentless harassment from Tanaka's troops, Shima Katsutake kept smiling and met their attacks with perfect composure.
units.source_zh: 面对田中部的死缠烂打，岛胜猛始终面带微笑，从容应对。

paragraphs.source_zh: 此时，从前面的沟堑中向岛左近胜猛发起进攻的田中吉政人马，且战且退，且退且战。面对田中部的死缠烂打，岛胜猛始终面带微笑，从容应对。

paragraphs.source_en: The Aikawa River lay to the left of Aozuka, and beyond it rose the densely wooded Mount Ibuki; not even in his dreams could Shima Katsutake have imagined that the enemy would approach so swiftly.

units.source_en: The Aikawa River lay to the left of Aozuka, and beyond it rose the densely wooded Mount Ibuki; not even in his dreams could Shima Katsutake have imagined that the enemy would approach so swiftly.
units.source_zh: 青冢左边是相川，河对岸就是林木茂密的伊吹山，岛胜猛做梦也想不到，敌人竟会迅速靠近。

paragraphs.source_zh: 青冢左边是相川，河对岸就是林木茂密的伊吹山，岛胜猛做梦也想不到，敌人竟会迅速靠近。

paragraphs.source_en: Bang! Bang! Bang! A deafening volley of gunfire erupted.

units.source_en: Bang! Bang! Bang!
units.source_zh: 砰砰砰！

units.source_en: A deafening volley of gunfire erupted.
units.source_zh: 震天的枪声响了起来。

paragraphs.source_zh: 砰砰砰！震天的枪声响了起来。

paragraphs.source_en: “Ah!” With a cry of agony, Shima Katsutake's body leapt high into the air; he crashed to the ground and lost consciousness on the spot. The shot fired by Suga Rokunosuke had struck Shima Katsutake.

units.source_en: “Ah!”
With a cry of agony, Shima Katsutake's body leapt high into the air; he crashed to the ground and lost consciousness on the spot.
units.source_zh: 一声惨叫，岛胜猛身体高高弹起，落在地上，当场昏倒。

units.source_en: The shot fired by Suga Rokunosuke had struck Shima Katsutake.
units.source_zh: 菅六之助放出的这一枪，命中了岛胜猛。

paragraphs.source_zh: “啊！”一声惨叫，岛胜猛身体高高弹起，落在地上，当场昏倒。菅六之助放出的这一枪，命中了岛胜猛。

paragraphs.source_en: Katsutake's men immediately burst into panicked cries and scattered in all directions. Several men carried the wounded Katsutake on their backs, dodging bullets as they retreated behind the palisade.

units.source_en: Katsutake's men immediately burst into panicked cries and scattered in all directions.

units.source_en: Several men carried the wounded Katsutake on their backs, dodging bullets as they retreated behind the palisade.
units.source_zh: 几个人背着负伤的胜猛躲避着枪弹，退到了栅栏内。

paragraphs.source_zh: 胜猛的人马顿时哇哇大叫，狼奔豕突。几个人背着负伤的胜猛躲避着枪弹，退到了栅栏内。

paragraphs.source_en: “Now is our chance! Charge in!” The Kuroda troops surged forward with thunderous battle cries. Nor was that all: taking advantage of the confusion, the Tanaka, Takenaka, Ikoma, and Kanamori contingents also crossed the ditch.

units.source_en: “Now is our chance!
units.source_zh: “机会来了！

units.source_en: Charge in!”
units.source_zh: 杀进去！”

units.source_en: The Kuroda troops surged forward with thunderous battle cries.
units.source_zh: 黑田士众高声呐喊着冲了上来。

units.source_en: Nor was that all: taking advantage of the confusion, the Tanaka, Takenaka, Ikoma, and Kanamori contingents also crossed the ditch.
units.source_zh: 不仅如此，田中、竹中、生驹、金森各部，也趁乱越过壕沟。

paragraphs.source_zh: “机会来了！杀进去！”黑田士众高声呐喊着冲了上来。不仅如此，田中、竹中、生驹、金森各部，也趁乱越过壕沟。

paragraphs.source_en: The Gamō troops, who had fought shoulder to shoulder with Shima Sakon, could no longer hold their ground outside the palisade and were driven steadily back. Mitsunari's main force and Mai Hyōgo's troops then hurried to their aid, but that came later and need not be recounted here.

units.source_en: The Gamō troops, who had fought shoulder to shoulder with Shima Sakon, could no longer hold their ground outside the palisade and were driven steadily back.

paragraphs.source_en: Across Sekigahara, a bloody tempest raged.
